In the epic adventure of The Jim Henson Company’s Farscape, Astronaut John Crichton (Ben Browder) assumes he'll be home in time for dinner, but a freak accident during an experimental space mission catapults him across a thousand galaxies to an alien battlefield. Suddenly, he's trapped among alien creatures wielding deadly technology - a battle that 20th century sci-fi pop culture never prepared him for. Hunted by a merciless military race, Crichton begins his quest for home from a galaxy far, far away. Created by Rockne S. O'Bannon. Starring Ben Browder, Claudia Black, Anthony Simcoe, Lani John Tupu, Jonathan Hardy, Gigi Edgley, Wayne Pygram, Virginia Hey, Paul Goddard.

In dem epischen Abenteuerfilm Farscape der Jim Henson Company glaubt der Astronaut John Crichton (Ben Browder), rechtzeitig zum Abendessen zu Hause zu sein. Doch ein verrückter Unfall während einer experimentellen Weltraummission katapultiert ihn durch tausend Galaxien auf ein außerirdisches Schlachtfeld. Plötzlich ist er zwischen außerirdischen Kreaturen gefangen, die mit tödlicher Technologie ausgestattet sind – ein Kampf, auf den ihn die Science-Fiction-Popkultur des 20. Jahrhunderts nicht vorbereitet hat. Gejagt von einer gnadenlosen Militärrasse, beginnt Crichton seine Suche nach seiner Heimat in einer weit, weit entfernten Galaxie. Erstellt von Rockne S. O'Bannon. Mit Ben Browder, Claudia Black, Anthony Simcoe, Lani John Tupu, Jonathan Hardy, Gigi Edgley, Wayne Pygram, Virginia Hey, Paul Goddard.

The Ghost of Faffner Hall is a music education series from 1989. Faffner Hall is a grand music conservatory where the residents -- human, animal and monster -- enjoy making music of all types. After the Hall's founder, Fughetta Faffner, dies, her ghost continues to haunt the hall. Eventually the Hall falls into the hands of her villainous, music-hating great-great-grandnephew, Farkas Faffner. He moves in, and wants to rid the Hall of its collection of musical instruments. Fughetta's ghost is forced to work overtime to defeat Farkas's schemes.

recentItems.title: Crichton Shakes Butt in His Most Daring Honeytrap Yet | Farscape
recentItems.description:
Part of the old Moya crew finally reunited after months of separation, Chiana is unhappily paired with untrustworthy newcomer Sikozu to stop the latter's ruthless former employers, the Grudeks, from scavenging the ship. Meanwhile, John Crichton employs an unorthodox method to lure the Grudek's alien bloodhound into a trap.

From season 4, episode 1 of Farscape; "Crichton Kicks".
